column12: guards now get a clone; Save still writes atomically
column14: `Set` updates a key in place or appends it, [`Unset(key, false)`](ds:block?id=unset-ahj88kj2) comments it out reversibly (`true` removes the line), and [`Save` writes atomically](ds:block?id=writeto-eemankjv).

column12: guards still run first and a refusal still writes nothing; they now get a clone
column14: The temp file is [renamed over the destination](ds:block?id=writeto-eemankjv). A rename within one directory is atomic, so a reader sees either the old file or the new one, never half of one, and a crash before the rename leaves the original intact.

column12: rewritten for the Compose re-entry rule: earlier definition, then Lookuper, then unset
column14: While a variable is being expanded, [a reference back into it](ds:block?id=visitingenter-r4jp8kdd) sees only the definitions above the line being expanded, then the Lookuper, then nothing.

column12: Set now records the quote style it renders; the sentence is unchanged
column14: [`Set(key, value)`](ds:block?id=set-jusdwzq7) updates the key where it is, or appends `KEY=value` at the end when the key is missing.
